name: Stavropol-Grozny Gas Pipeline

values.Owner: Gazprom transgaz Grozny / Gazprom transgaz Stavropol

monitor_reason: length: only the 76 km inside Chechnya is sourced (Gazprom transgaz Grozny); total Stavropol-Grozny length is unsourced, so (d) fails. Legs (a) sponsor Gazprom and (b) endpoints Stavropol-Grozny pass; (c) is satisfied by operating status (built 1957, in service 1959).
researcher_notes: Not in roster: P0793 is Stavropol-Moscow, P2343 Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk, P0751/P1471/P5875 other Mozdok trunks; no Grozny-ending row exists, so not matched_existing. Existence confirmed by 3 sources: Gazprom transgaz Grozny About page (Wayback 20250617; live host timed out) says first main gas pipeline Stavropol-Grozny, 500 mm, 76 km within the republic, in service 1959; Gazprom transgaz Stavropol history page (Wayback 20250617) says Stavropol-Grozny construction completed 1957 (Gazprom group pages, same corporate origin, not independent); nangs.org history lists Stavropol-Grozny among trunks commissioned that year (year not confirmed from text read; 529/720/1020 mm pipe era). sdelanounas.ru/etokavkaz.ru (Apr 2021) states the 101.7 km Mozdok-Grozny was laid in one corridor with the 'existing' Stavropol-Grozny trunks, supporting operating status in 2021. Whole-line length, route and capacity not found; the 76 km figure is a Chechnya-only share and must not be entered as LengthKnown for the full line. Promote to new_row only if a source gives total length or a Chechnya-only segment row is accepted (start would be the Chechnya/Stavropol Krai or Dagestan-side boundary, unsourced). Possible overlap with later reconstruction or loops is untested. Candidate values listed are for reference if promoted; Fuel/Owner are inferred from the Gazprom operator pages. Confidence medium.  No GEM or banned sources cited.
